findings.body: `toRowLabel` copies every outline label after the first into `otherLabels` and never sets `hiddenOtherLabelCount`. If a budget-only GL occurs under more than twenty distinct MIS labels, the response and disclosure become unbounded, contrary to the required bounded `rowLabels` contract. Apply the same cap used for SAP name groups and carry the remainder in `hiddenOtherLabelCount`; add an overflow case for budget fallback.

findings.body: The only test that executes the generated resolver SQL against Postgres is guarded by `WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST`; the supplied close output explicitly reports this test as skipped. The passing tests otherwise feed precomputed rows through fake warehouses, so they cannot catch invalid normalization, grouping, ranking, or scope SQL. A skipped test is hollow under the required test audit, and no close-run evidence shows the optional warehouse-proof command passed.

The task plan assigns that production crossing to GL-ANSWER-WIRING, so this remains follow-up advice rather than a blocker for this task alone.
